owner: Original ONE BRAIN failure coverage and Powerhouse observability owners
root_cause: Original admin portal showed only aggregate error counts and predictive recovery. The exact original technical checkout and SEO source fixes were independently live, but the separate native GitHub Actions PR-create authorization remained open. Aggregating into a single green website status would overstate actual autonomous handoff and financial outcomes.
prevention_rule: Preserve separate exact-fingerprint readbacks of original checkout, SEO date-only source fix and native PR-create authorization. Treat technical source recovery, future natural execution and permissions as distinct states; never infer a paid order, successful native PR creation or complete incident closure. Require exact allowlisted Supabase provider rows, fail-closed data/status on unavailable or partial readback. Admin-only server summary, no raw evidence in UI, no duplicate agents or cron.
